title: The Aether-Scalar-Tensor Dark Sector Is a gamma = 2 Polytrope: the Cluster Helmholtz Phase Is Its Mass, It Pins Dynamically, and It Fills About a Quarter of the Core
description: Relativistic MOND completions leave a factor-~2 missing-mass residual in galaxy-cluster cores. In Aether-Scalar-Tensor (AeST) theory the static weak-field equation for the potential is a modified Helmholtz equation, div[M(x) grad Phi] + mu^2 Phi = 4 pi G rho_b (Durakovic & Skordis 2024), whose homogeneous solutions oscillate; the boundary constant, 'the oscillation phase', sets an effective core mass and has been treated as a free parameter. A companion paper (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20779562) found the resulting potential-depth lever real and galaxy-safe but descriptive, and named a 3-D N-body phase-pinning calculation as the single un-closed branch; three earlier dynamical solves found no pin because a free Klein-Gordon mode at omega = mu c is undamped. We show, from the action, that the phase belongs to a different branch. With K(Q) = K_2 (Q - Q_0)^2 and the k-essence identities p = L, rho = Q L' - L, the AeST Q-sector dust obeys p_d = (2 pi G / mu^2) rho_d^2, a gamma = 2 (Lane-Emden n = 1) polytrope, with c_s^2 = 4 pi G rho_d / mu^2 = 2w, and in a static well, where Q = (1 - Psi) Q_0, c_s^2 = |Psi| c^2 and rho_d = -mu^2 Psi / (4 pi G), exactly the Durakovic-Skordis phantom. Hydrostatic equilibrium of this polytrope IS the Helmholtz equation, and the free constant is the polytrope's Bernoulli constant, i.e. its captured mass; the n = 1 radius pi/mu is mass-independent, which is the whole freedom. The Klein-Gordon equation the earlier solves integrated has a Yukawa static limit and is the gapped branch. Because sign(rho_d) = sign(c_s^2), any static branch carrying dust on a potential hill has a gradient instability growing at |c_s| k (4.4 e-folds per Hubble time already at k = mu for |Psi| = 1e-6), so every node-bearing branch is excluded; all ten branches of the matched cluster boundary-value problem carry one. The physical configuration is the unique positive polytrope with a free surface inside pi/mu, and a one-dimensional Lagrangian gamma = 2 hydrodynamic solve of dust falling into the growing MOND well of a 1e15 Msun cluster reaches it (force residual 1%, Mach 0.10 residual motions, core mass ratio 1.00 to the static solution) while a +-50% free-mode admixture in the initial conditions changes the core mass by <= 3%: the phase pins. With the captured mass set to the cosmic dust share inside R500, the core (< 420 kpc) receives 2.3-3.4e13 Msun, 23-33% of the 1e14 Msun residual across both a0 footings and both interpolating kernels, galaxy-safe by geometry (a Milky-Way share leaves 9e7 Msun inside 20 kpc). The same configuration gives eta(R500) = 2.57 on the framework's kernel, within 10% of the raw eRASS1 value 2.33 with zero tuning, but overshoots the weak-lensing-corrected 1.7 on every kernel while undershooting the core: only 3% of the captured dust sits inside 420 kpc, because the profile rho_d ~ C - Psi cannot be more concentrated than the potential. The shape, not the amount, is the binding limit. The lever scales as (mu R)^2 and exists only at AeST's phenomenological mu^-1 ~ 1 Mpc. Two statements of the companion paper are withdrawn: the dust is not pressureless inside wells, so the density-ordering veto does not apply, and no N-body run is needed to settle the phase. The cluster core gap remains at least 65% open. All results are reproduced by committed scripts; a0, kappa and the dust amplitude I_0 are inputs, never derived.
notes: Companion to and partial correction of DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20779562 (two statements withdrawn, Sec. 7). Both-ways discipline throughout: the phase-pinning result and the zero-tuning R500 match are credited at full weight AND the R500 overshoot, the 23-33% core yield and the mu-dependence are reported at full weight; the cluster core gap remains at least 65% open. Priority ledger in Sec. 8 (Scherrer 2004; Guendelman, Nissimov & Pacheva 2016; Chavanis 2021; Boehmer & Harko 2007; Mistele, McGaugh & Hossenfelder 2023; Blanchet & Skordis 2024). All quantitative claims reproducible from https://github.com/carlzimmerman/zimmerman-formula (qwen_claude_field_theory/closure_2026/cluster_phase_2026/, all scripts exit 0, mutation controls exit 1). Quarantine: a0/kappa/I0 never asserted derived. Not a discovery paper, not a theory of everything.
